tool_input.command:
R=/tmp/smoothmag-admin-verify
printf '{"master_key": "%s"}
' "$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64)" > "$R/notification.json"
printf '#!/bin/sh
printf "===MAIL ARGS: %%s\n" "$*" >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail.log
cat >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail.log
printf "\n" >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail.log
exit 0
' > "$R/capture-mail.sh"
printf '#!/bin/sh
printf "===MAIL ARGS: %%s\n" "$*" >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail-fail.log
cat >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail-fail.log
exit 1
' > "$R/capture-mail-fail.sh"
chmod +x "$R/capture-mail.sh" "$R/capture-mail-fail.sh"
cat "$R/notification.json"; sh -n "$R/capture-mail.sh" && echo MAILSCRIPT-OK
